sentences.text:
Through: Mr.Mukesh Kumar, App for 
 with Wsi Shalu, Ps S
 Coram:
 Hon'Ble Mr. Justice Yogesh Khanna
 Order
1. Exemption allowed, subject to all just exceptions.

2. The application stands disposed of.
3. Petitioner is seeking quashing of the FIR No.235/2022 under Section 376 IPC registered at police station Saket on the complaint of respondent No.2 on the basis of the settlement.
Learned APP for the State accepts notice and seeks to file status report.
Be filed before next date of hearing with an advance copy thereof to the learned counsel for petitioner.
5. Notice be issued to respondent No.2 through all modes returnable on next date of hearing.

KHANNA, J.
FEBRUARY 21, 2023 M Saurabh Singh vs The State Nct Of Delhi & Anr on 21 February, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/19554780/
